desc: Read input N, K, and the sequence A. Compute prefix sums S where S[0]=0 and S[i] = S[i-1] + A[i] for i=1..N, all modulo 998244353.
Precompute binomial coefficients binom(K, j) for j=0..K using Pascal's triangle or factorials.

Initialize an array `sum_powers[p]` for p=0..K to store the sum of S[i]^p for all processed prefix indices i. Initially, only S[0]=0 is processed, so `sum_powers[p]` = 0^p (which is 1 if p=0, else 0).
